category_title: Students with limited mobility requiring physical scaffolding for digital interaction
scenario_title: Physical scaffolding for iPad literacy app interaction
minimal_context: Matthew is using the 'English Alphabet for kids 4' app on an iPad secured to his wheelchair and needs to tap screen icons to progress through the story.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's use the 'English Alphabet for kids 4' app on your iPad. Tap the screen icon to start the story.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the iPad secured to the arm of his wheelchair, trying to lift his hand to make a pointing gesture but unable to support its weight.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and tap the icon.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (His hand drops back down, unable to maintain the pointing gesture near the screen independently.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You have to tap the relevant on-screen icon to make the story progress.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Watches the story activity unfold on-screen but cannot independently point to and tap the icon without someone supporting the weight of his hand.)

dialogue_combined:

STUDENT: (Looks at the iPad secured to the arm of his wheelchair, trying to lift his hand to make a pointing gesture but unable to support its weight.)

TUTOR: Go ahead and tap the icon.

STUDENT: (His hand drops back down, unable to maintain the pointing gesture near the screen independently.)

TUTOR: You have to tap the relevant on-screen icon to make the story progress.

STUDENT: (Watches the story activity unfold on-screen but cannot independently point to and tap the icon without someone supporting the weight of his hand.)
